payload.title: [Fig. 5] Ensemble resampling
payload.summary: This notebook explores ensemble resampling techniques for the Last Millennium Reanalysis, generated using an Ensemble Kalman Filter. It demonstrates the challenges of maintaining both the posterior distribution and temporal structure of climate variability. The notebook applies various resampling strategies, including autoregressive models, fractional Gaussian noise, and power-law scaling, to the offline data assimilation ensemble. The results are visualized and compared to highlight the importance of choosing appropriate resampling methods.
goals: Illustrate challenges in ensemble resampling for climate data.
Apply naive and advanced resampling strategies to the LMR ensemble.
Compare different resampling methods and their effects on temporal structure.

section_blurbs.blurb: Introduces the concept of ensemble resampling in the context of the Last Millennium Reanalysis and the challenges of maintaining distribution and temporal structure.
section_blurbs.heading: [Fig. 5] Ensemble resampling

section_blurbs.blurb: Discusses the need for independent information to respect the laws of physics in climate variability and introduces methods for spectral analysis and covariance estimation.
section_blurbs.heading: Independent constraints on temporal structure

section_blurbs.blurb: Explores three timeseries models for resampling: autoregressive, fractional Gaussian noise, and power-law behavior, using the median spectrum as a target.
section_blurbs.heading: Resampling the offline LMR

section_blurbs.blurb: Details the use of autoregressive models for resampling, addressing the issue of stationary models and variance scaling.
section_blurbs.heading: AR resampling

section_blurbs.blurb: Describes the application of power-law scaling for resampling, highlighting its equivalence with fractional Gaussian noise under certain conditions.
section_blurbs.heading: Power law scaling

section_blurbs.blurb: Explains the use of fractional Gaussian noise for modeling long-memory processes and its application in resampling the LMR ensemble.
section_blurbs.heading: fGn resampling

section_blurbs.blurb: Summarizes the resampling options available in the `pens` library and emphasizes the necessity of parametric models for effective resampling.
section_blurbs.heading: Conclusion

outputs: Plots of ensemble traces and standard deviations
